title: Constrained Delaunay mesh of a cylinder: volume within the chordal bound, valid elements
source: mesh invariants: an inscribed polygon of sagitta s loses at most 2s/R of a circle's area (elementary geometry); constrained Delaunay tetrahedralization after Diazzi et al., ACM TOG 42(6) 2023

quantities.reason: the tessellation inscribes the cylinder within the chordal tolerance s = 0.05: the polygon section loses between 0 and 2s/R = 0.5% of the area; the reference is the middle of that band
quantities.fixture_reason: the volume depends on the surface mesh from solidcore_tess::mesh, which is not bit-identical across platforms (macOS aarch64 6258.668, Linux x86-64 6258.805; tangency-labs/solidcraft#16417). The tet mesher gives the same mesh for the same surface on every platform, so the quantity can be frozen again once the surface mesh is reproducible; until then the reference tolerance gates it

quantities.quantity: elements that fail the certified Jacobian check
quantities.reason: every element of a valid mesh has positive volume
